agenda_items.section: II. OPEN COMMENT AND COUNCIL STAFF RESPONSE 6:30 PM
agenda_items.title: Tim Thomas – Spoke about Council having dinner behind closed doors in the Kitchen. He also noted that the city use pad at the St. James Hotel was being used for non-city purposes.

agenda_items.section: II. OPEN COMMENT AND COUNCIL STAFF RESPONSE 6:30 PM
agenda_items.title: Brad Golden – Spoke against utilization of license plate recognition software. He wanted any data related to non-criminal activity to be purged immediately.

agenda_items.section: II. OPEN COMMENT AND COUNCIL STAFF RESPONSE 6:30 PM
agenda_items.title: Dr. R. Paul Williamson – Spoke about a project called Colorado City Connector. The program would build a memorail system linking cities in Colorado using a new technology.

agenda_items.section: II. OPEN COMMENT AND COUNCIL STAFF RESPONSE 6:30 PM
agenda_items.title: Jeff McWhirter – Spoke as the president of the Southeast Boulder Neighborhood Association and as a citizen against the annexation of the Hogan-Pancost property.

agenda_items.section: II. OPEN COMMENT AND COUNCIL STAFF RESPONSE 6:30 PM
agenda_items.title: Steve Romancase – Spoke against the annexation of the Hogan-Pancost property without a change in the zoning.

agenda_items.section: II. OPEN COMMENT AND COUNCIL STAFF RESPONSE 6:30 PM
agenda_items.title: Lee Berg – Spoke on behalf of United Way thanking Boulder for its support during their many challenges.

agenda_items.section: II. OPEN COMMENT AND COUNCIL STAFF RESPONSE 6:30 PM
agenda_items.title: Stacey Balcom – Spoke about the bandshell and annual duck race.

agenda_items.section: II. OPEN COMMENT AND COUNCIL STAFF RESPONSE 6:30 PM
agenda_items.title: Lynn Segal – Spoke against the annexation of the Hogan-Pancost property.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC HEARINGS -- 6:45 PM
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved Ordinance No. 7917 finding that the conditions precedent to formation of an electric power and light utility of Charter Section 178(a) have been satisfied.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 7918 AUTHORIZING THE ACQUISITION OF PUBLICLY INTERESTS OWNED BY PUBLIC SERVICE COMPANY OF COLORADO BY A NEW ENERGY BY NEGOTIATION AND PURCHASE THROUGH THE POWER OF EMINENT DOMAIN AND SETTING FORTH RELATED DETAILS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved Ordinance No. 7918 authorizing the acquisition of property interests owned by Public Service Company of Colorado d/b/a Xcel Energy by negotiation and purchase or through the power of attorney.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 7919 setting the bail of title for an amendment to the Boulder Charter, amending North Reclaimed Utilities
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved Ordinance No. 7919, setting up a ballot title for an initiative referendum to the Boulder Charter.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 7920 SUBMITTING TO THE REGISTERED ELECTORS OF THE CITY OF BOULDER AT THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL COORDINATED ELECTION TO BE HELD ON TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 3, 2013, AN ALTERNATIVE BALLOT QUESTION AMENDING THE CITY CHARTER TO ADDRESS ISSUES PRESENTED BY THE PROPOSED INITIATIVE CHARTER AMENDMENT THAT ADDS A NEW SECTION 188 ON LIMITATIONS ON DEBT IN CREATION AND SAVING FOR MUNICIPAL DEBT DETAILS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved Ordinance No. 7920 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder in the general municipal coordinated election to be held on Tuesday, November 5, 2013, an alternative ballot question amending the City Charter to address issues presented by the proposed limited Charter amendment that adds a new section .88 on limitations on receipt and use of debt.
